organization_note: Microsoft Corporation, of Redmond, develops the MAI models through Microsoft AI and publishes the Phi models and ONNX Runtime GenAI, and Microsoft Azure operates Microsoft Foundry Models. The catalog names the developer and runtime maintainer Microsoft and the Foundry operator Microsoft Azure, so both names belong to this record. Its AI work is not only where its headquarters is. The same page describes its offices city by city, and two are research and engineering sites in other countries: its London AI hub, where "researchers, engineers, and product teams advance language models, build foundational AI tools, and drive responsible innovation", and its Beijing campus, home to Microsoft China and the Asia Pacific R&D Group. Those two countries are this record's work locations; the page's other cities, Redmond, New York City, Berkeley, San Francisco, Mountain View, and Hyderabad, are in the United States, which is already the headquarters.
